newsitem.title: USA: Smartalk to acquire ConQuest Tel.
newsitem.headline: Smartalk to acquire ConQuest Tel.

text.p: Smartalk Teleservices Inc said Thursday it signed a definitive agreement to acquire ConQuest Telecommunication Services Corp, a Dublin, Ohio-based developer and marketer of prepaid calling cards and other enhanced telecommunications services.
Smartalk said it will issue about 4.8 million shares of its common stock in connection with the transaction.
It is anticipated that this transaction will be accounted for under the purchase method of accounting, Smartalk said.
The parties currently anticipate the transaction to be completed in the fourth quarter, Smartalk said.
Through a strategic merger with ConQuest, Smartalk said it will add more than 6,000 storefronts to its distribution channel.
Smartalk said the combined company will have a retail telecommunications distribution channel with access to about 35,000 locations under existing distribution agreements.
